notes: DrandBeacon permissionlessly verifies drand evmnet BLS signatures on BN254. GammaGame uses the specified pool manager and IMD addresses and the deployed beacon for the GAMMA proof-of-play game. Its fixed 800M GAMMA reserve is released in 10-minute epochs; survivors share Shares and failures share the evening Harvest. Claim fees fall from 80% to 10% over 24 hours and are split among burning, unclaimed bonuses and Harvest. GammaGame deploys uninitialized; $owner is its one-time configurator.
